entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • DirectiveParser roots Assembly.Location and blocks Native AOT consumers #84574
  • Merge dotnet/roslyn-sdk into dotnet/roslyn #84573
    .NET 11
  • sporadic and random MissingMethodException followed by termination on arm64 MacOS durring build/analyze #84571
  • SyntaxNode actions related to unions trigger multiple times #84570
  • EnC/Hot Reload: `GetPreviousMethodHandle` fails for a delta‑added source‑generated method on a later update (`MethodsAdded` tracking lost across generations) #84569

Closed

  • Razor support for roslyn-language-server #82535
    18.8
  • Ref safety diagnostics downgraded to warnings even in some safe contexts #83564
    18.7

PullRequests

Created

  • Split Razor components into decl/impl before tag-helper resolution #84577
    Area-Razor
  • Disable hidden redundant pattern diagnostics by default #84576
  • File-based apps: avoid running a few irrelevant editor features #84575
    VSCode
  • Defer Introduce Parameter's call-site search to when the action is applied #84572
    VSCode
  • Stop advertising unavailable previews for dialog code actions #84568
    Community

Merged

  • [release/dev17.14] Migrate PR validation azure-public feed auth from PAT to WIF service connection #84511
  • [release/insiders] Migrate PR validation azure-public feed auth from PAT to WIF service connection #84512
  • [release/stable] Migrate PR validation azure-public feed auth from PAT to WIF service connection #84513
  • [release/dev18.0] Migrate PR validation azure-public feed auth from PAT to WIF service connection #84514
  • Remove per-feature Razor code generation opt-ins #84567
    VSCode
  • Add missing feed configuration to our pr-validation pipeline #84566
  • Optimize DecisionDagBuilder with Tests.ValueSet for large or-patterns #83513
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Razor
  • Unsafe evolution: report error for `unsafe` with no effect #84378
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Adjust/add unions tests #84565
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Handle iterator safe contexts in ref safety analysis #84254
    Area-Compilers

Updated

  • Implement LSP daemon mode #84199
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3024408 #84534
  • Fix false positive with Color Color static member access #84533
    VSCode
  • Use vscode-uri semantics for parsing URIs #83593
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Nullable annotate Symbol.ContainingType #84536
  • Add support for extension constants #84238
    Area-Compilers, Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review, VSCode, Area-Razor, Feature - Extension constants
  • Allow MSBuildWorkspace to open file-based apps #84139
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Feature - Run File
  • Fix: LINQ implicit anonymous type property allows ref structs, causing runtime TypeLoadException #84485
  • Bump Microsoft.Build to 18.7.1 and mark ShowMessageForImplicitlySkipAnalyzers multithreadable #84343
    Community
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #83901
    Area-Infrastructure, Needs API Review
